title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Offset for the Owner's Own Short Notice Moves
content:
## Dispatch note

A reschedule offset is taken off the credit owed on a Preventive Maintenance Agreements record where the owner has themselves moved booked visits inside the tier's notice period. The count is of the charges for a short notice reschedule standing on the agreement.

- Where **2 or more** charges for a short notice reschedule stand on the agreement, the major reschedule offset, **160.00 USD**, is taken off.
- Where **exactly 1** charge for a short notice reschedule stands on the agreement, the reschedule offset, **75.00 USD**, is taken off.
- Where **no** charge for a short notice reschedule stands on the agreement, no reschedule offset is taken off.

### Note

The offset is the single figure the count selects, not a figure per charge: two such charges and five such charges alike take the major reschedule offset of 160.00 USD.

### Illustration (hypothetical)

A credit figure of 900.00 USD on an agreement carrying exactly 1 charge for a short notice reschedule has 75.00 USD taken off it, leaving 825.00 USD. The same figure on an agreement carrying 3 such charges has 160.00 USD taken off, leaving 740.00 USD.
